"""Spawn a target, wait until it blocks (stdin kept open), then memdump it.

Usage: python cap.py <workdir> <tag> [stdin_text] [delay]
Writes <workdir>/<tag>.bin + .idx.json ; prints pid; kills process.
"""
import sys, os, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"<G5A_WORKDIR>").resolve()

def safe(p) -> Path:
    rp = Path(p).resolve()
    if rp != ROOT and ROOT not in rp.parents:
        raise ValueError(f"path outside ROOT: {rp}")
    return rp

def main():
    wdir = safe(sys.argv[1])
    tag = sys.argv[2]
    stdin_text = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 'hello\n'
    delay = float(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 1.0
    p = subprocess.Popen([str(wdir / 'app.exe')], cwd=str(wdir),
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    time.sleep(delay)
    if stdin_text:
        try:
            p.stdin.write(stdin_text.encode()); p.stdin.flush()
        except Exception as e:
            print('stdin write failed:', e)
    time.sleep(delay)
    if p.poll() is not None:
        out, err = p.communicate()
        print(f'exited early rc={p.returncode} out={out!r} err={err!r}')
        return
    print(f'pid={p.pid}')
    r = subprocess.run(['<PY312>', str(ROOT / '_work' / 'memdump.py'), str(p.pid), str(wdir / tag)],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(r.stdout, r.stderr)
    try:
        p.kill()
    except Exception:
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
